title: Orbit under repeated computation rounds
statement: Let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape Turing machine on a fixed input, and assign a natural-number duration to each configuration. Starting from a configuration $c$, the configuration after $r$ rounds is obtained by repeating $r$ times the operation that runs $M$ from the current configuration for its assigned duration.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number of work tapes
A symbol alphabet and state type
A duration function from configurations to natural numbers
A natural number of rounds r
